help.label: Help · {n}
help.a1: A sequence of messages, waits, and decision branches that starts from a trigger like signup, cart abandonment, or purchase completion.
help.q2: How do I optimize my flows?
help.a2: Keep the opening step short, branch by intent early, and measure drop-off at each node so you know where conversion slips.
help.q3: Which flows should I launch first?
help.a3: For most stores: welcome → cart recovery → post-purchase review. That covers acquisition, conversion, and retention with minimum overhead.

logic.emptyGroupWarning: This group has no rules, so it is always false. Add a rule or remove the group.
logic.conditionTreeInfo: Rules are grouped. Each group combines its rules and sub-groups with AND (all must match) or OR (any can match). The whole tree either evaluates to TRUE (then the IF · true port fires) or FALSE (then the ELSE · false port fires). Groups nest up to {depth, plural, one {# level} other {# levels}}, with at most {rules, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}} in total.{flat, select, true { This node still uses the old flat list until you edit it here.} other {}}
logic.problemRules: {count, plural, one {# rule has} other {# rules have}} no variable.
logic.problemGroups: {count, plural, one {# empty group.} other {# empty groups.}}
logic.flatInfo: All the rules below are combined into ONE expression using the AND / OR toggles. The whole expression either evaluates to TRUE (then the IF · true port fires) or FALSE (then the ELSE · false port fires). Add rules to make it more specific; chain with AND (all must match) or OR (any can match).

trigger.orderPlaced: Fires for every new order. The order's customer is matched to a saved contact and enrolled.
trigger.automatic: Fires automatically — no extra config needed.
trigger.away: Fires on any incoming message while Away mode is ON. Toggle Away mode from the Auto Reply page. Each contact is enrolled once.
trigger.outOfHours: Fires on any incoming message that arrives outside your workspace Business Hours. Set Business Hours in your workspace settings. Each contact is enrolled once.
trigger.manualEnroll: You'll enroll contacts manually from the /flows list via the Enroll button next to this flow.

ext.groupLeaveHint: Runs when a contact is taken out of this list by a person or an import. A flow that removes them itself does not start it.
ext.segmentLeaveHint: Runs once each time a contact who was inside this segment is found outside it after being updated, tagged or listed. A contact is only noticed leaving if the flow saw them inside first.
ext.segmentHint: Runs once per contact, the first time they are found inside the segment after being created, tagged, listed or updated.
ext.fieldHint: The field key: name, email, title, language, address, or a custom field's key.
ext.valueHint: Checked each time the contact is created or changed. A contact runs once for each value it takes.
ext.timeZoneHint: In your workspace's time zone. Checked once a day.
ext.monthDayHint: 31 means the last day of a shorter month.
ext.tzHint: An IANA name such as Asia/Kolkata. Blank uses your workspace's time zone.
ext.whoHint: At most 5,000 people per run. Contacts who opted out, are archived or have no number are left out.
ext.productIdHint: Blank = any product in the order.
ext.storeNote: The customer is matched to a saved contact by phone number; nobody is created for an order. “Added to cart” and “product viewed” are not offered: the store does not report them.
ext.updatedNote: Fires when a person or an import changes a contact, each time. A change made by another flow does not start it.

faq.exitNoMatch: nothing was close enough, FAQ answering is switched off for the platform, the linked flow or step is gone, or the message was empty.
